crossRefs.note: For they intended evil against you. They plotted evil against you which cannot succeed.
Moreover I saw under the sun, in the place of justice, that wickedness was there; and in the place of righteousness…
No one sues in righteousness, and no one pleads in truth. They trust in vanity, and speak lies. They conceive mischief…
He judged the cause of the poor and needy; so it was well, then. Wasn’t this to know me?” says Yahweh.
But your eyes and your heart are only for your covetousness, for shedding innocent blood, for oppression, and for doing…
In you have they taken bribes to shed blood. You have taken interest and increase, and you have greedily gained of your…
Her princes within it are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, and to destroy souls, that they may get…
I said, “Please listen, you heads of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel: Isn’t it for you to know justice?
Please listen to this, you heads of the house of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel, who abhor justice, and…
The chief priests therefore and the Pharisees gathered a council, and said, “What are we doing? For this man does many…
Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?
Woe to those who decree unrighteous decrees, and to the writers who write oppressive decrees;
The way of the just is uprightness. You who are upright make the path of the righteous level.

translations.web: No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands in the earth.
translations.bsb: No, in your hearts you devise injustice; with your hands you mete out violence on the earth.
translations.kjv: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.
translations.asv: Nay, in heart ye work wickedness; Ye weigh out the violence of your hands in the earth.
